lightIdle: Thayipha noma yikuphi ikheli lewebhusayithi. Sihlola uhlu lwethu lwezinsongo, isakhiwo, ukulingisa kwezimpawu, i-DNS nempendulo ekhona manje. Ku-Misa: phuma, qinisekisa ngesiteshi esisemthethweni osesethemba, bese ubika uma uthanda.
lightLimited: Kucacile kusho ukuthi ukuhlola okwenziwe akuzange kube nesexwayiso esinamandla — akusona isithembiso sokuthi isayithi iphephile.
privacyNote: Okuzenzakalelayo: akugcinwa lutho. Ukuhlola amaphutha kusiza ukulungisa izinkinga zobuchwepheshe kuphela — soze kube yikheli, futhi soze kube ukukhishwa komphakathi.
privacyPolicyIntro: I-buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (umugqa wemikhiqizo ye-Buusdo — umkhiqizo ohlukile) ikusiza ukuthi uhlola ikheli lewebhusayithi ngaphambi kokuthi ulithembe. Ukuhlola kusetshenziswa izimpawu zethu uqobo nohlu lwethu lwezinsongo oluqondisiwe. Leli khasi yisaziso sobumfihlo somkhiqizo sewebhusayithi, i-extension yesiphequluli, nohlelo lwedeskithophu.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Uma uqalisa ukuhlola, ikheli olifakayo licutshungulwa kuseva ye-buusdo ukuze kuhlaziywe isakhiwo, kufaniswe nohlu lwethu lwezinsongo, futhi ngokuzikhethela kuhlolwe ukufinyeleleka okukhona manje (i-DNS / i-HTTP). Asithumeli ama-URL ahloliwe ku-Google Safe Browsing noma kwamanye ama-API edumela enkampani yesithathu, futhi asithengisi idatha yokuhlola.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Okuzenzakalelayo: akugcinwa lutho. Ungakhetha ukugcina kule divayisi kuphela (uhlu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba, umlando wokuhlola ongakukhetha) kusiphequluli, ku-extension, noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu. Ukuhlola amaphutha kokusekela okuzikhethelayo kufaka umthombo nohlobo lwensongo kuphela — soze kube ikheli eligcwele, futhi soze kube ukukhishwa komphakathi noma ukukhangisa.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: I-buusdo ayiniki i-akhawunti yefu noma ukuvumelanisa kohlu phakathi kwamadivayisi. Uhlu lwakho lokuvimbela/lokuthemba luhlala kule divayisi. Luhambise ngokukhipha/ukungenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1, noma uvumelanise ngokwakho ifayela le-shield-backup.json yedeskithophu (i-USB, i-Drive, i-Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Ngemibuzo yobumfihlo noma yomkhiqizo, xhumana nomsebenzi wokumisa kwakho kwe-buusdo nge-imeyili yakhe esemthethweni noma ngesiteshi sokusekela (umuntu noma inhlangano eqhuba i-Cloudflare Worker). Khetha lelo kheli elisemthethweni oselazi — hhayi ucingo noma i-imeyili eprintwe kusayithi oyihlolayo. Unganamathiseli imiphumela yokuhlola ebucayi eziteshini zomphakathi.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Akukho ukukhishwa kwe-TLS — i-HTTPS CONNECT yigama lomshini kuphela; akukho sitifiketi se-MITM. Akukho ukubulawa kwezinqubo — izinhlelo ezisebenzayo ziyaqhubeka. Izinkomba zesistimu ziyabikwa kuphela — /usr, /etc, izindlela zesistimu ze-Windows, ne-Program Files azisoze zisuswe noma zihlelwe. Akukho injini ye-AV noma yamasignesha, futhi akukho ukubanjwa kwamaphasiwedi noma umlando wokuphequlula.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Faka i-buusdo kule khompyutha kusuka ku-GitHub Release (igobolondo lesiphequluli + ithreyi). Izakhiwo azisayiniwe — bheka umhlahlandlela wokusetha. Ukuvula uma ungena kuhlala kucinyiwe kuze kube uyikhipha.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Isakhiwo esingasayiniwe (asinganotari). I-macOS ingavimbela ukuvula kokuqala — landela umhlahlandlela wokusetha (i-xattr / Privacy & Security). I-Windows SmartScreen ingaxwayisa ngoMshicileli ongaziwa.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Inothi elidala: ukukhushulwa okunotariwe akusetshenziswa kule ndlela yokuthumela — gcina i-zip ye-GitHub engasayiniwe njengeyokuqala.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Ukulanda kwe-macOS yedeskithophu: isibuko se-CDN siyasebenza; i-GitHub Release ihlala iyindlela ebhaliweyo yokubuyela.
privacy: Lokhu kuhlola kuhlala kule khompyutha. Awugcinwa umlando wokuphequlula.
invalid: Faka ikheli elivumelekile le-HTTP noma i-HTTPS.
ignoreRiskBody: Unganikeza amaphasiwedi, imininingwane yokukhokha, noma enye idatha yomuntu siqu kulowo olawula leli kheli. Vala ithebhu ngaphambi kokuthayipha noma ukukhokha noma yini.
nextStepLeave: Phuma kuleli khasi manje — ungakuqhubeki ekhelini olihlolile.
nextStepNoCredentials: Ungafaki amaphasiwedi, izinombolo zamakhadi, amakhodi e-SMS/imeyili, noma enye idatha yomuntu siqu kule sayithi.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Qinisekisa ngokuzimela: vula isizinda noma uhlelo lwesikhathi esisemthethweni senhlangano osesethemba kakade (ibhukhimakhi, ikhadi lebhanga, isitolo sohlelo olwaziwayo). Ungasebenzisi izingcingo noma ama-imeyili akhona ekhasini elisolisayo.
nextStepReport: Ngokuzikhethela: gcina ngezansi umbhalo wesikhashana wendawo ukuze umsebenzi abuyekeze umshini wohlolo uhlu lwezinsongo oluqondisiwe.
nextStepBlock: Ngokuzikhethela: vimbela umshini ku-extension noma uhlelo lwedeskithophu lwe-buusdo ukuze kube nzima ukuwuvula ngephutha.
nextStepLooksReal: Amakhasi okukhwabanisa avame ukubukeka ehlanzekile futhi asebenzise i-HTTPS. Ikhwalithi yokubukeka ayifakazeli ukuthi isayithi isemthethweni.
honestLimitNoWipe: I-buusdo ayikwazi ukusula ulwazi lomuntu siqu iwebhusayithi eseyiluqoqile. Shintsha amaphasiwedi kusayithi yangempela esemthethweni uma ufake noma yini, bese ubheka izexwayiso zebhanga/imeyili.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Imiphumela ivela ohlwini oluqondisiwe kanye nezimpawu zekheli ze-buusdo — hhayi isibalo somphakathi sokuthi bangaki abantu ababike isayithi.
honestLimitNoAv: Lena akuyona imkhiqizo yokulwa namagciwane. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha lapha; ayiskeni noma ihlanze idivayisi yakho.
actionSensitiveNote: Ungafaki ulwazi olubucayi ngaphandle kokuba unakuqinisekisa ikheli ngomthombo ozimele.
feedbackReportExportHint: Umbhalo wesikhashana ugciniwe. Vula Izilungiselelo → Imibhalo yesikhashana yempendulo ukuze ukhiphe ifayela le-batches/*.json ukuze umsebenzi abuyekeze — akukho okuthunyelwayo.
faqNoWipeTitle: Ingabe i-buusdo ingasula idatha isayithi eseyiyithathile?
faqNoWipeBody: Cha. Shintsha amaphasiwedi kusayithi yangempela esemthethweni uma kufakwe lutho, bese ubheka izexwayiso zebhanga noma ze-imeyili.
faqNoAvBody: Cha. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha okwengeziwe kulelo kheli; akuskeni noma kuhlanze idivayisi.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Ingabe amaphuzu avela ezivotini zabanye abasebenzisi?
faqNoCrowdBody: Cha. Imiphumela isebenzisa uhlu lwezinsongo oluqondisiwe lwe-buusdo nezimpawu zekheli — hhayi isibalo somphakathi sokuthi bangaki abantu ababike lokhu.
protection: Sebenzisa i-extension noma uhlelo lwedeskithophu ukuze ubuyekeze uhlu lokuvikela.
currentlyBlocked: ivinjelwe ku-extension noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu uma uyengeza lapho.
resetDone: Umlando wendawo, imibhalo yesikhashana, nokhiye bohlu obudala kusuliwe.
blockListsWebsiteNote: Le webhusayithi ayiphoqeleli uhlu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba (i-extension nedeskithophu kuyenza lokho). Uhlu luhlala kudivayisi.
blockListsOfflinePath: Indlela phakathi kwamadivayisi: khipha noma ngenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 ku-extension noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu. Ideskithophu ingavumelanisa ne-shield-backup.json nge-USB, i-Drive, noma i-Syncthing — akukho akhawunti yefu.
listsOfflineIntro: Uhlu lokuvimbela nolokuthemba luhlala kudivayisi ngayinye. Akukho akhawunti yefu ye-buusdo. Sebenzisa ukukhipha/ukungenisa noma ukuvumelanisa kwefayela.
listsOfflineStepExport: Ku-extension noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu, khipha i-shield-lists-v1 (i-JSON noma i-QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Kopisha ifayela noma skena i-QR kwedivayisi eyodwa (i-USB, i-Drive, umyalezo owuzithumelela wona).
listsOfflineStepImport: Ngenisa kwedivayisi eyodwa. Kungcono umbhali oyedwa ngesikhathi.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: Uhlelo lwedeskithophu lugcina uhlu njenge-shield-backup.json kufolda yedatha yalo. Ungavumelanisa leyo folda nge-Syncthing, i-Drive, noma i-USB. Uma amadivayisi amabili ebhala ngesikhathi esisodwa, khipha futhi kudivayisi oyithembayo bese ungenisa kwenye.
accountHint: Ngokuzikhethela. Vumelanisa uhlu lomuntu siqu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba kuphela phakathi kwewebhusayithi, i-extension, nedeskithophu. Soze kube umlando wokuhlola noma ama-URL agcwele.
accountDisabled: Ukuvumelanisa kwe-akhawunti kucinyiwe kule seva (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Sebenzisa isipele esingaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngezansi, noma cela umsebenzi ukuthi akuvule ukuvumelanisa.
accountMagicSent: Uma lelo kheli lingamukela iposi, isixhumanisi sokungena sithunyelwe (ukuthuthukisa kungabonisa isixhumanisi ngezansi).
accountSyncToggleHint: Uma kuvuliwe, okuthi Vumelanisa manje kucindezela futhi kudonsa i-shield-lists-v1. Ukuphuma akusuli uhlu lwefu.
accountStagingPlaceholder: Namathisela i-JSON ye-shield-lists-v1 ukucindezela, noma Vumelanisa manje ukudonsa.
accountDeleteConfirm: Sula le akhawunti kanye nesithombe sohlu lwefu? Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiselwa. Uhlu lwendawo ku-extension/ideskithophu aluthintwa.
accountSignOutNote: Ukuphuma akusuli uhlu lwefu. Ukusula i-akhawunti kuyakwenza lokho.
accountOfflineBackup: Isipele esingaphandle kwe-inthanethi: khipha noma ngenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 kusuka ku-extension noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu.
accountSyncNeedPrivacy: Khetha Le divayisi kuphela noma Ukuhlola amaphutha kokusekela ngaphambi kokuvumelanisa ukulungiselela kohlu kule sayithi.
accountSyncEmpty: Awukho uhlu lwefu okwamanje — namathisela i-JSON bese ucindezela uVumelanisa manje ukulayisha.
accountListsTooMany: Kunezinhlamvu eziningi kakhulu zokuvimbela/zokuthemba ukuvumelanisa kwefu.
accountListsTooLarge: I-JSON yohlu idlula umkhawulo wosayizi wefu.
blockListsPrivacySurfaces: Ku-Ungagcini nhlobo: i-extension isula uhlu lomuntu siqu ku-chrome.storage; uhlelo lwedeskithophu luyabuza ngaphambi kokusula i-shield-backup.json kudiski.
blockListsLiveDeepLink: Ukuvimbela nokuthemba kusebenza ku-extension / ideskithophu — vula amadokhumenti okufaka
leaveAndBlockSettingsCta: Vula Izilungiselelo — uhlu lokuvimbela lusebenza ku-extension / ideskithophu
ambiguousProbeNotPhishing: Ukuvinjelwa kwe-bot noma ukuncishiswa kwenhlolo akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa — vula isayithi kusiphequluli esijwayelekile uma usayidinga.
probeBlocked403Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 403 (Forbidden). Isayithi yenqabile lokhu kuhlola okuzenzakalelayo — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekile uma kudingeka.
probeBlocked429Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). Isayithi inciphise lokhu kuhlola — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Linda bese uzama futhi, noma vula ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekile.
probeBlocked503Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). Isayithi noma umkhawulo ungase ugcwale — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusiphequluli esijwayelekile uma kudingeka.
personalListLeaveNote: Ukuphuma kuphakanyiswe uhlu lwakho lomuntu siqu lokuvimbela (i-extension / ideskithophu). Le webhusayithi ayilugcinanga uhlu.
settingsIntro: Ukukhetha kokuvikela okungabuyiselwa okugcinwe kulesi siphequluli kuphela. Ukuhlola izinsongo kusetshenziswa uhlu lwe-buusdo uqobo — ama-URL awathunyelwa ezinsizeni zedumela zenkampani yesithathu.
timingTimeout: Inhlolo iphelelwe isikhathi. I-CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS ephakanyisiwe: {suggested} (yamanje {current}; inhlolo ephelelwe isikhathi ephezulu {observed}).

historyFilterProbeBlockedEmpty: Akukho kuhlola kwenhlolo okuvinjelwe emlandweni wakamuva.
intelMergePtWriteOk: I-OWN_THREAT_MERGE_PT ibhaliwe — isimo sokuhlanganisa sisetshenziswe ngaso leso sikhathi.
intelMergePtWriteSessionOnly: Isimo sokuhlanganisa sisetshenziswe kulesi sikhathi. Ukubhala ku-.env.local kunqatshelwe (i-vinext ingase ikuvimbele) — kusetshenziswa ukweqa kwesikhathi sokusebenza / ifayela lokubuyela.

blockOnSurfaces: Ukuvimbela kuqhuba ku-extension yesiphequluli nasohlelweni lwedeskithophu — hhayi kule webhusayithi. Isayithi ihlola amakheli kuphela. Bheka Izilungiselelo ngamadokhumenti okufaka.

historyNoHeadFails: Akukho kwehluleka kwe-HEAD okuphindaphindiwe ekuhloleni kwakamuva.
errorTimeout: Ukuhlola okukhona manje kuphelelwe isikhathi. Zama futhi noma khuphula i-CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.

historyNote: Isizinda, izinga lobungozi, i-ms yenhlolo nokuphelelwa isikhathi kuphela — soze kube ikheli eligcwele. Kusulwa uma iDatha iku-Ungagcini nhlobo.
historyTimeoutHostsNote: Ukuphelelwa isikhathi okuphindaphindiwe lapha kuvame ukusho khuphula i-CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS, noma umshini uvimbela ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo. I-CSV yesifinyezo sokuphelelwa isikhathi ifaka ikholomu ye-probeBlocked (inani lokuhlola okuvinjelwe kwe-403/429/503 ngomshini — soze kube i-URL egcwele).
historyExportCsvHelp: Amakholomu e-CSV yesifinyezo sokuphelelwa isikhathi: domain, timeouts, checks, max/last probe ms, budget, headFails, headSkips, probeBlocked.
historyNoTimeouts: Akukho kuphelelwa isikhathi kwenhlolo ekuhloleni kwakamuva.

feedbackFalsePositive: Ifulegi elingalungile — umbhalo wesikhashana wokuphutha okuhle
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: Ngemva kombhalo wesikhashana wokubika i-Misa: qhakaza uhlu ngezansi, khipha i-batches/*.json, bese umsebenzi usebenzisa i-npm run threat:apply. Akukho okuthunyelwa kulesi siphequluli.

evidenceNoMatchDetail: Ayikho insongo eyaziwayo etholwe ohlwini lwethu. Lokhu akufakazeli ukuthi isayithi iphephile.

evidenceHttpDetail: Ulwazi oluthunyelwe nge-HTTP lungase lubonakale endleleni.
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: Indlela iphakamisa ukuthi ikhasi lingase licele ulwazi olubucayi. Qinisekisa isizinda ngokuzimela.
evidenceDnsFailDetail: Umshini akaphendulanga. Isayithi ingase ibhalwe kabi noma ingafinyeleleki.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: Isicelo silandele ukudluliswa okukodwa noma ngaphezulu.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: I-HTTPS ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Ungafaki ulwazi olubucayi.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Isayithi ifinyelelwa nge-IP esikhundleni segama lesizinda elijwayelekile.
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Lesi siphetho sisetshenziswa kakhulu emikhankasweni yokukhwabanisa. Sodwa asifakazeli umonakalo.
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: Izichungechunge ezinde zezizinda ezingaphansi ngezinye izikhathi zisetshenziswa ukubukeka semthethweni.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Ikheli libeka imfihlo ku-query. Inani aligciniwe.

evidenceUserBlockDetail: Lo mshini ukuhlwini lwakho lomuntu siqu (i-extension noma uhlelo). Isayithi ayilugcinanga uhlu.

limitationNoContent: Lokhu kuhlola akuhlaziyi okuqukethwe kwekhasi futhi akufakazeli ukuthi ubani olawula isizinda.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: Ukuhambisana kobunikazi akuqinisekisi ukuthi zonke izenzo kusayithi ziphephile.
limitationNoThirdParty: Ama-URL awathunyelwa ku-Google Safe Browsing noma kwezinye izinsiza zedumela zenkampani yesithathu.

riskLevelHighNote: Izimpawu zexwayiso eziningi ezibhaliwe zidinga ukunakwa ngokushesha.
riskLevelCautionNote: Kutholwe ukungaqiniseki okubalulekile noma izimpawu zexwayiso.
riskLevelLowEvidenceNote: Ayikho insongo eyaziwayo etholwe emithonjeni ehloliwe.
riskLevelUnknownNote: Abukho ubufakazi obanele ukufinyelela esiphethweni esiqinisekile.
recommendLeaveAndBlock: Phuma futhi uvimbele lesi sizinda (ku-extension noma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu)
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Kutholwe i-HTTP {status}. Isayithi ivimbele noma inciphise lokhu kuhlola — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekile uma kudingeka.
faqCommonIntro: Izimpendulo ezimfushane ngalokho i-buusdo eyikwenzayo nalokho engakwenzi — ziwusizo ngaphambi kokuthi uthembe umphumela we-Misa.
proxyGuideLead: Blocking only applies to clients that use this HTTP proxy. Without it, the log stays quiet.
proxyGuideMac: macOS: System Settings → Network → your interface → Details → Proxies → Web proxy (HTTP) → 127.0.0.1 port 8080. Leave HTTPS unchecked unless you only need CONNECT host refusals.
proxyGuideWin: Windows: Settings → Network & internet → Proxy → Manual setup → Use a proxy server → Address 127.0.0.1 Port 8080.
proxyGuideLinux: Linux: set http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:8080 for the app, or your desktop’s Network proxy → HTTP 127.0.0.1:8080.
proxyGuideBrowser: Browser: prefer OS proxy, or an extension that sends HTTP through 127.0.0.1:8080. Do not install any MITM certificate — this product never decrypts TLS.
proxyGuideAfterBlock: Hosts were blocked. Set the HTTP proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080 or the log stays empty.
themeHeaderHint: Use the one Appearance button in the header (next to language).
